attempts.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as the DHCP server on the private network it shares with node2 and node3 (eth1/ens7/ens7, subnet 10.50.50.0/24, pool .100-.200), and configured node2/node3 to obtain that interface's address via DHCP instead of remaining unconfigured/static, all implemented via an Ansible playbook run from node4 (the only node with Ansible pre-installed, hence the control node). Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart-and-recovery pass on all 4 managed nodes.
